name: De Quervain Tenosynovitis
definition: Painful stenosing tenosynovitis/tendinopathy involving the first dorsal extensor compartment, usually abductor pollicis longus and extensor pollicis brevis.

typical: Pain with thumb motion, lifting or grasping

investigations.MRI: Ultrasound may clarify tendon-compartment anatomy or guide injection.
investigations.radiographs: Radiographs when fracture or CMC OA is suspected.

green: Activity modification and thumb-spica support when helpful
amber: Corticosteroid injection and surgical release are options for persistent cases after individualized assessment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Manibandha/Angushtha-region Snayu/Vata phenotype may be documented descriptively.

patientEducation.summary: Painful stenosing tenosynovitis/tendinopathy involving the first dorsal extensor compartment, usually abductor pollicis longus and extensor pollicis brevis.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
